decision: The competitor (Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team) is fined €5,000.
offence: Breach of Article 34.14 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative and reviewed video evidence. Car 44 was released from the garage in an unsafe manner dragging a jack and an exhaust extractor behind it. The Stewards acknowledge that the team immediately informed the driver to stop to prevent any further damage and/or dangerous situation.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 44 Unsafe Release
to: The Team Manager, Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team
